grounding_rule: Commentary is written manually only from the extracted captions/transcript, without Gemini. Main verse reference blocks are separately verified directly against vedabase.io; uncertain captioned recitations remain flagged.
hindi_notes_rule: The Hindi note is written from this lecture's own original Hindi captions (the class is delivered in Hindi), not translated from the English note. Its structure, section order and timestamps mirror the English note, and it introduces no claim the English note does not also make. vedabase.io has no Hindi Bhagavad-gita edition, so its verse markers resolve to the same English-verified <Shloka> blocks.
caption_availability_note: YouTube offers both hi-orig (original) and an auto-translated en track for this video. The hi-orig track is the authoritative source for both notes; the en track is a machine translation of the same audio and was rate-limited (HTTP 429) at extraction time, so only the hi-orig VTT is stored in work/.
